Tabitha Jackson named director of Film Forum

She assumed the role on February 23, 2026. Read more.

Founding Repertory Artistic Director Bruce Goldstein presented with the 2026 TCM Robert Osborne Award

The award is presented annually to an individual whose work has helped preserve the cultural heritage of classic film for future generations. Congratulations to Bruce!

Film Forum named one of the world’s best cinemas

We are honored to be named 3rd best cinema in the world (and best in NYC!) by Time Out and included in Financial Times list of "The 24 most breathtaking cinemas in the world"
